focus_crystal.name: Focus Crystal
focus_crystal.lore: Cold and clear. The Focus Offering in the Astral Court wants it.

mind_key.name: Mind Key
mind_key.lore: Opens the shuttered door to the Mindstar Observatory.

waves.say: Your reflections step out of the mirrors.

onDone.text: The mirrors go dark. A Focus Crystal hovers over the plate.
The wall remembers you. The stair beyond unfolds.

mechanics.failText: Forgotten. Read the colours on the wall again.

onDone.text: The stars chime in turn. A tablet-niche opens in the north wall.

mechanics.failText: The stars go dark. Read them on the dome: light blue, white, pink, purple, magenta.

onDone.text: The lens refocuses. A hidden study opens in the south-east wall.

onStep.text: The lens swings. One more lever.

mechanics.jam: The lens is out of focus. Use the near lever first.

onOpen.text: The altar focuses. The gate of the Memory Vault slides aside.

mechanics.hint: A cold altar with a hollow shaped like a crystal.
mechanics.verb: sets the Focus Crystal on the altar and the vault gate slides aside.

onOpen.text: The shutters of the Mindstar Observatory open.

mechanics.hint: A shuttered door with a keyhole that is not quite where you look.
mechanics.verb: turns the Mind Key and the shutters fold away.

encounters.say: The gallery is full of you. Some of you move on their own.
The dome shows five stars in a fixed order. A crystal altar waits in the south.

bosses.name: The Mindstar
bosses.intro: The Mindstar opens its eyes. Shatter the three amethyst wards on the pillars to break its focus.
bosses.deathText: The Mindstar goes dark, and every star in the dome with it.

shield.breakText: The wards shatter! The Mindstar is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Mindstar calls its servants.

effects.text: The dome shows only the Mindstar.

pads.text: The stairs fold. You step onto the second landing.
The stairs fold again. The third landing.
A pull behind the eyes. You are back at the first landing.

completion.intro: The Mindstar Observatory. Fold the stairs, remember the colours, and reach the Astral Court.
completion.message: The dome dims. The observatory closes shortly.
